content:
Aisha Khatri: Hey @NovusLabs — I saw your support ticket about the token showing up in Console but getting 403 when used. Can you paste the exact curl you ran (please redact the full secret)?
NovusLabs - Dev (customer): Sure — pasted below. We created the account via SSO and followed the onboarding steps. Token is visible in the UI but requests are blocked.

```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_example123\" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings -d '{\"input\":\"test\"}'
```
Response: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":{"type":"permission_error","message":"API key not authorized for project: novus-prod"}}
```
Aisha Khatri: Thanks. Elena, do you see anything in the CS Console about the token/project binding? :thinking_face:
Elena Ortiz (CS): I pulled a screenshot from the tenant view — the token metadata shows it as attached to \"novus-staging\" even though the onboarding flow selected \"novus-prod\". Looks like a mismatch.
Samir Patel: @Carlos can you check provisioning logs? We've seen a race where token creation runs before the project create callback completes and the token falls back to the org's first project.
Carlos Mendez: Tailing provisioning service logs now. I can reproduce similar sequence: callback delay -> token created -> auto-bound to first project. Attaching snippet (sanitized):

```
[provisioning] INFO create_token tenant=org-novus request_id=abcd123
[provisioning] WARN callback_not_ready tenant=org-novus
[provisioning] INFO create_token token=sk_generated project_id=null
[provisioning] INFO bind_token token=sk_generated project_id=proj-0002  # proj-0002 == novus-staging
```
Julia Park: That sounds like the PROV-42 race condition we already have a fix for in staging. The short-term operational workaround is to rebind the token to the correct project via the admin rebind endpoint. Example: 

```
POST /v1/admin/tokens/rebind
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <admin-api-key>
Body: {"token":"sk_generated","project_id":"proj-0001"}  # proj-0001 == novus-prod
```
Note: this requires an admin key and will be audited.
Aisha Khatri: @Julia can you perform the rebind? Novus is blocked in production and needs immediate fix.
ProvisionBot: Automated note: rebind operation queued by Julia Park (job id jb-7788).
Carlos Mendez: I executed the rebind and confirmed the token metadata now lists project=novus-prod. 

```
[admin] INFO rebind_token token=sk_generated from_project=proj-0002 to_project=proj-0001 actor=julia
[admin] INFO rebind_success token=sk_generated
```
NovusLabs - Dev (customer): Re-ran the same curl and now it's 200. Thanks so much, team. :raised_hands:
Aisha Khatri: Great — I'll add a customer-facing note and escalate a prod hotfix for PROV-42. @eng-runtime @eng-infra FYI (routing to the engineering channels).
Julia Park: I'll open a hotfix PR to backport the staging fix to prod and add a check that blocks token creation until provisioning callbacks succeed or a short TTL for unbound tokens. Also adding alert for provisioning callback latency > 2s.
Samir Patel: For tracking: ticket PROV-42 assigned to julia, priority P1 for hotfix. Workaround documented in runbook under \"token rebind admin flow\".
DeployBot: deploy/redwood-provisioning v1.2.8 -> prod queued by julia/PROV-42
Carlos Mendez: I'll keep monitoring provisioning service logs for similar failures and post any other tenants affected.
Aisha Khatri: I'll follow up with Novus tomorrow to confirm nothing else pops up. Closing this thread once the hotfix is verified in prod. :thumbsup:
